release.name: 9700E150_20261119v14
release.label: 20261119v14
release.title: IC-9700 E 1.50 + transverter + ICAP decoders, beacon, QSO mode, APRS & PSKReporter (20261119v14)
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF on 2 m, 70 cm or 23 cm), RF shown up to 122 GHz
Separate active transverter for MAIN and SUB (SET > Transverter > MAIN Active / SUB Active); DUAL watch shows each receiver's own RF
MAIN/SUB exchange swaps the transverter selection together with the bands
SAT mode: transmit settings (power cap, TX delay, PTT inhibit) follow SUB Active; normal mode: MAIN Active
Per-transverter maximum TX power, TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes) and PTT inhibit
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms (6-byte BCD above 1.4 GHz, as IC-905)
Scope Set > Scope dB/div: 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 dB per division for spectrum and waterfall, noise floor anchored automatically (MAIN and SUB independently)
SD-card apps: MENU > SET > Apps (\IC-9700\Apps\)
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER while connecting DC (~5 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM - 20261119v14'; the radio's version text stays official 1.50
SD-card decoder apps (ICAP): Q65, FT8, JT4, PI4 and WSPR on the DECODE screen, WSJT-X-style output

Automatic PSKReporter spotting: every decode is reported when your own callsign and locator are set on the radio and it has network (the firmware carries no personal data; spot frequency is the true on-air RF, transverter-aware)

On-radio beacon: in a decoder mode, a LONG press of the mode tile in the emission popup arms / disarms a period-aligned beacon (DE <call> <locator>); while armed, a red rounded frame marks the main-screen emission button
Per-transverter ATT and P.AMP: each TRV slot keeps its own attenuator / preamplifier setting, applied when the slot becomes active
DECODE > SET in a decoder mode: SUBMODE (JT4 A..G, Q65 A..E) and PSKREPORT (ON / OFF) per mode, kept by the radio
WSPR-2 decoder (the WSPR app now decodes and can beacon)

QSO mode for FT8, Q65 and JT4 (verified on IC-705 E and IC-9700): tap a decoded line on the DECODE screen, the app proposes the next message of the standard sequence as a 'TX? ...' line; wait about a second and tap that line - the radio sends it once in the period opposite to the other station ('QSO: TX armed'). A tap that comes too early shows 'QSO: wait 1 s, tap again'. The radio never advances a QSO by itself

CQ calling: keep holding the mode tile after the red (beacon) frame appears until it turns green (about three times the beacon hold) and release - CQ in every second period until disarmed or a station is selected. Green frame = CQ / QSO transmission, red frame = beacon; nothing is armed while the finger is down
PTT, EXIT or TRANSMIT end a transmission at once and block further ones until the next deliberate tap
QSOs are logged as ADIF records in Apps\ICAPQSO.ADI on the SD card (the file is only ever appended to)
If the radio refuses to transmit, the DECODE screen now says why: 'TX refused: <reason>' names the condition that is not met

APRS (new): MENU > SET > GPS > GPS TX Mode has a 4th choice 'APRS' - position beacon as 1200 Bd AFSK on the current frequency, FM only; received APRS stations appear in the radio's RX History. Needs APRS.APP from the SD-apps bundle in \Apps\; the loader starts and stops it by itself with the menu choice

NEW FIRMWARE IMAGE in this release: the image and the SD-apps bundle 20261119v14 must be installed TOGETHER (copy ALL files of the bundle to \IC-9700\Apps\, update the firmware, power-cycle). The runtime files ICAPRT / ICAPTX / ICAPSPOT / ICAPCOLD.BIN of this bundle are refused by the older image and the older ones by this image - the radio then runs without apps
